function.name: describe_parameter
function.description: Choose the requested parameter's final state; no execution

adapted_messages.content:
Read the actual request and choose ONE final state for the specified parameter. unchanged: keep this file exactly. absent: this file must be gone. present: require existence only. initial:NAME: exact original bytes from NAME. unsupported: ANY requested encryption, byte transformation, computation, process or network effect. unclear: the intended final effect is unspecified. Reject the WHOLE request if any effect is unsupported, even if this parameter is only preserved. Use unchanged for preservation, not initial:self. This is a draft requiring caller review.

Parameter to describe: {"name": "source", "type": "path", "role": "source file"}
Answer with ONE letter only.
Choices:
A: unchanged
B: absent
C: present
D: initial:source
E: initial:destination
F: unsupported
G: unclear
